Name: Auto Consume for Heal and Buff
Author: minnie0175
Description:
This mod makes you consume selected item in your inventory whenever your HP is low(less than 30% of total), and whenever your buff has ended. You can select each heal and buff item in your inventory.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Press 'O' to open the menu. You can turn on/off each feature and decide which item to consume. If you used all of the selected item, the menu would automatically appear. The menu will appear only when you have edible items in your inventory. You can also set the time to stop consuming the buff item.


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.8 on macOS/Windows.
[*]Works [b][i][color=#ff0000][u]only in single player[/u][/color][/i][/b] mode.
[/list]
